seoTitle: Crucible — a native Plex client for iPhone, built on Linux
metaDescription: Crucible is a fast, native Plex client for iPhone with offline downloads, Skip Intro, Picture-in-Picture, lock-screen controls, Cast & Crew, and Handoff — open source, zero dependencies, and built entirely on Arch Linux without Xcode.
heroHeadline: Your Plex library, done right on iPhone
heroSubhead: A fast, native Plex client with offline downloads, Skip Intro, Picture-in-Picture, lock-screen controls, and Handoff — open source, zero dependencies, and built entirely on Arch Linux without ever opening Xcode.
highlights: Offline downloads with a Lock Screen Live Activity and background transfers
Skip Intro/Credits, PiP, and background audio
Direct play with automatic HLS transcoding fallback
Open source under GPL-3.0 — zero third-party dependencies

features.title: A player that respects your time
features.body: Skip Intro and Skip Credits from Plex markers, Picture-in-Picture, background audio, and lock-screen controls. Credits roll the next episode automatically.

features.title: Take it offline
features.body: Download movies, whole seasons, or single episodes at the quality you pick — from Original down to Data Saver. Downloads keep running in the background, interrupt gracefully and auto-resume from where they left off, and stay Wi-Fi-only unless you say otherwise. A Live Activity tracks progress on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island — a WidgetKit extension compiled and signed entirely on Arch Linux via xtool.

features.title: Plays anything
features.body: Direct play when your device handles the file natively, automatic HLS transcoding through Plex's universal transcoder when it doesn't.

features.title: Browse the way you think
features.body: Continue Watching, On Deck, and Recently Added up front. Poster grids with genre filters and sort, plus raw folder browsing for unindexed content.

features.title: Discover more
features.body: Cast and crew, More Like This recommendations, subtitle and audio track selection, and adjustable playback speed on every title.

features.title: Continues across devices
features.body: Watch progress syncs to your server, resume picks up where you left off, and Handoff plus Spotlight carry titles between your devices.

features.title: Built different
features.body: Swift 6 and programmatic UIKit with Liquid Glass on iOS 26, cross-compiled on Arch Linux and deployed over USB. No Xcode, no macOS, no dependencies.

howItWorks.body: Authenticate with Plex over OAuth. Crucible discovers your servers and picks the best reachable connection automatically.
Jump back into Continue Watching, scan your poster grids, or search across everything you own.
Direct play or transcode, skip the intro, send it to Picture-in-Picture, and let Up Next roll the next episode.

faq.q: Is Crucible on the App Store?
faq.a: No. Crucible is a free, open-source personal project — not an App Store release. You build it from source and deploy it to your own iPhone with xtool, or grab a tagged release from GitHub.

faq.q: Do I need a Mac or Xcode to build it?
faq.a: No. That's the whole point. Crucible is written in Swift 6 and programmatic UIKit, cross-compiled on Arch Linux with SwiftPM, and deployed to an iPhone over USB via xtool. No Xcode, no storyboards, no macOS anywhere.

faq.q: What does it need to run?
faq.a: An iPhone on iOS 17 or later and a Plex Media Server you can reach. Crucible talks directly to your server — it works great over Tailscale for secure remote access.

faq.q: Does it support Skip Intro, PiP, and lock-screen controls?
faq.a: Yes. Skip Intro and Skip Credits come from Plex chapter markers, Picture-in-Picture and background audio keep playback going, and the lock screen and Control Center drive play, skip, scrub, and next episode.

faq.q: Can I download movies and shows to watch offline?
faq.a: Yes. Download movies, full seasons, or single episodes at the quality you choose — Original, High, Medium, Low, or Data Saver. Downloads run in the background and resume after interruptions, stay Wi-Fi-only unless you allow cellular, and live in a dedicated Downloads tab with progress and storage usage. A Live Activity shows live progress on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, and a notification fires when a download finishes while you're away. Offline playback uses the same player, so Skip Intro/Credits, resume, PiP, background audio, and lock-screen controls all work with no network.
Yes — GPL-3.0, with zero third-party dependencies (pure Apple frameworks). Read the code, file an issue, or fork it on GitHub.
